name: Podcasts
author: Casper Bottelet
description: A podcast client in the bar: an episode inbox you triage in seconds, a queue that plays itself through mpv with per-show speed and voice boost, chapters, and OPML import and export.

schema.label: Check for new episodes every
schema.description: Minutes between feed polls. Shows are staggered and jittered so they never all fetch at once.

schema.label: Default speed
schema.description: Playback speed for shows that have no speed of their own.

schema.label: Voice Boost
schema.description: Levels quiet talk against loud music and ads (mpv dynaudnorm).

schema.label: Podcast Index API key
schema.description: Optional. Leave empty to search the iTunes directory, which needs no account.

schema.label: Podcast Index API secret
schema.description: Optional. Paired with the API key above.

schema.label: Downloads at once
schema.description: How many episodes download in parallel.

schema.label: Largest episode to download (MB)
schema.description: Episodes bigger than this are refused. Video episodes can be large.

schema.label: Delete played downloads after (days)
schema.description: A downloaded episode you have finished is deleted this many days later. 0 keeps it.

schema.label: Feed shows the last (days)
schema.description: How far back the Feed tab looks across all your shows.
